subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Residents said light for one building should not destroy privacy for another.”?
options: The young trees were small, but they grew new leaves.
The city required privacy screens and trees between the buildings.
Their teacher said cooling a city requires many methods: shade, materials, water, buildings, and behavior.
After reading the report, the city office decided to plant more trees on the west side of the road.
